title: Croatian Quesadilla Tortilla
description: A hearty twist on traditional quesadillas, blending Croatian flavors with Mexican comfort food.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Lay a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with cheese.
Add a few slices of prosciutto on one half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the other side is also crispy.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
